acceptanceCriteria.description: docker compose -f docker/compose.qa.yaml up --build starts full stack successfully
Client at http://localhost:8081 loads and communicates with server via /api/ proxy
CONTROL_PLANE_API configurable via environment variable at container start
Nginx proxy_pass target configurable via API_UPSTREAM environment variable
docker compose -f docker/compose.e2e.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit runs test suite
Production deployment steps removed from WORKFLOW.md (steps 32-38)
cloudbuild.release.yaml archived to cloudbuild.release.yaml.archive or removed
cloudbuild.yaml modified to only build/push images (no deploy steps)
Client container runs standalone with docker run -e CONTROL_PLANE_API=... -e API_UPSTREAM=...
Worker-linux profile still functional in both compose files

integration.name: QA Compose Stack Validation
integration.description: Validate compose.qa.yaml starts all services and they become healthy
integration.successCriteria: All services report healthy; no errors in logs

integration.name: E2E Compose Stack Validation
integration.description: Validate compose.e2e.yaml starts stack and runs integration tests
integration.successCriteria: Test runner exits with code 0; test results produced

integration.name: Runtime Config Validation
integration.description: Verify CONTROL_PLANE_API and API_UPSTREAM are configurable at runtime
integration.command: docker run --rm -e CONTROL_PLANE_API=http://test:8080/api/ -e API_UPSTREAM=test:8080 <client-image> /bin/sh -c 'cat /usr/share/nginx/html/config.js | grep CONTROL_PLANE_API'

integration.name: Standalone Client Validation
integration.description: Verify client container works standalone with external API
integration.command: docker run -d --name client-standalone -p 8081:8081 -e CONTROL_PLANE_API=http://host.docker.internal:8080/api/ -e API_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:8080 <client-image> && sleep 5 && curl -f http://localhost:8081/ && curl -f http://localhost:8081/api/health

integration.name: Nginx Config Validation
integration.description: Verify nginx proxy_pass uses API_UPSTREAM env var

integration.name: Worker Profile Validation
integration.description: Verify worker-linux profile works in both compose files
integration.command: docker compose -f docker/compose.qa.yaml --profile workers config && docker compose -f docker/compose.e2e.yaml --profile workers config

e2e.name: Full Local QA Flow
e2e.description: End-to-end manual QA flow: start stack, access UI, verify API calls work
steps: Verify API calls succeed via DevTools Network tab

e2e.name: Full E2E Integration Flow
e2e.successCriteria: Test runner exits 0; test artifacts produced

human.name: Local QA Developer Experience
human.description: Developer can start QA stack, iterate on client code, and tear down cleanly
criteria: Clear error messages on port conflicts

requiredEvidence: Compose up logs (stdout/stderr) for QA and E2E stacks
HTTP response captures for client health and API proxy endpoints
Nginx configuration dumps showing runtime substitution
File existence proofs for documentation and archived cloudbuild
WORKFLOW.md diff showing production steps removed
Cloudbuild.yaml diff showing deploy steps removed
evidenceStandards.evidenceRetention: CI artifacts retained for 30 days; local evidence in .evidence/ directory
evidenceStandards.revisionPinning: All evidence tied to git SHA at time of test execution

regressionRequirements: Any change to compose files must re-run AC-01 and AC-05
Any change to Dockerfile.client must re-run AC-03, AC-04, AC-10
Any change to nginx.conf must re-run AC-04
Any change to WORKFLOW.md must re-verify AC-06
Any change to cloudbuild files must re-verify AC-07, AC-08
New compose profiles must verify AC-11
Flutter version upgrades must re-verify all ACs
